prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic close-up beauty moment at a European street-cafe terrace in soft daytime light, preserving the lip-gloss application and lifestyle-influencer framing.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with shoulder-length platinum-white blonde waves, light green-blue eyes, natural fair skin texture with subtle freckles, defined natural brows and soft neutral makeup. She wears a beige-taupe ribbed halter-neck top and applies red lip gloss with a silver metallic wand while looking toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 close-up from the face through upper shoulders, eye-level and straight-on. Keep the applicator near the lips and the beauty action clearly readable. Include wooden cafe tables and chairs, umbrellas, softly blurred patrons, stone buildings and a lively European street behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight evenly illuminates the face, hair, glossy lips and knit texture. Keep the mood casual, candid, feminine and warm-neutral without studio harshness.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 smartphone or mirrorless portrait, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes, lips, applicator and hair strands, natural skin texture, realistic glass and background bokeh, restrained color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic close-up beauty portrait at a European street-cafe terrace of one original approved adult woman with shoulder-length platinum-white blonde waves, light green-blue eyes, natural fair skin texture with subtle freckles, defined natural brows and soft neutral makeup. She wears a beige-taupe ribbed halter-neck top and applies red lip gloss with a silver metallic wand while looking toward camera. Use a vertical 3:4 eye-level close-up from face through upper shoulders, keeping the applicator near the lips. Include wooden cafe tables and chairs, umbrellas, softly blurred patrons and stone buildings in a lively street background. Use soft diffused daylight, sharp eyes and lip detail, realistic hair and knit texture, shallow depth of field and warm-neutral candid color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, cosmetic smears, invented logos, readable added text, recognizable public figure likeness
